prompts.title: New member welcome series
prompts.summary: Five short emails for a new member's first two weeks.
prompts.prompt: Write a five-email welcome series for new members at [gym]. Day 0: welcome and what to bring. Day 2: how the first class goes. Day 5: meet the coaches [names, one line each]. Day 9: the schedule and how to book. Day 14: check in, ask how it's going. Each under 120 words, signed by [owner]. No promises about weight loss or results.
prompts.use: Set it up once in your email tool and let it run.

prompts.title: Quiet member check-in
prompts.summary: A personal text for a member who hasn't been in for two weeks.
prompts.prompt: Write three versions of a short text from [coach] at [gym] to a member who hasn't checked in for two weeks. Warm, no guilt, one question, offer a class time [ ]. Under 30 words each, with a way to opt out.
prompts.use: Send them from your phone, one by one, every Thursday.

prompts.title: Six-week challenge plan
prompts.summary: Plans an in-gym challenge: the rules, the weekly posts, the check-ins and the finale.
prompts.prompt: Plan a six-week in-gym challenge at [gym] for [members or newcomers]. Price [ ]. Include: rules and what counts (attendance, not body weight), the weekly post, a weekly check-in message, the finale day, and how we'll celebrate. No before-and-after body photos, no weight-loss claims.
prompts.use: Run it twice a year. Count attendance, not pounds.
